item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Watch #VISPRSD
Issued at 10:00 AM 16 September 2026

Thunderstorm is MORE LIKELY to develop over #OccidentalMindoro, #Palawan, #Iloilo, #Guimaras, #Antique, #Capiz, #Aklan, #NegrosOccidental, #NegrosOriental, #Cebu, #Bohol, #Siquijor, #Leyte, #SouthernLeyte, #Biliran, #EasternSamar and #Samar within 12 hours.

All are advised to continue monitoring for updates.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 7 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 7 #VISPRSD
Issued at 09:46 AM 16 September 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Aklan(Malay, Buruanga, Nabas, Ibajay, Tangalan, Makato, Malinao, Madalag), #Antique(AniniY), #Iloilo(Oton, Pavia, Leganes), #Cebu(Consolacion, Liloan, Compostela and DanaoCity) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Antique(Libertad, Pandan, Sebaste, TobiasFornier), #Iloilo(SanJoaquin, IloiloCity), #Cebu(SantaFe, Daanbantayan and MandaueCity) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
